headline: Activision 🍆 Takes Halo 👑 As Xbox Axes 💼 268 Jobs
text:
Xbox 🎮 just dropped 🪓 another brutal 💉 round of cuts ✂️ in its neverending 🌀 "reset" 🔄 that already cooked 🍳 3600 🧮 total jobs 💼 across the board 🛠️ with 1600 📉 sliced immediately 🩸 right after Asha 🧑‍💼 Sharma called 📢 the gaming division 🕹️ not "healthy" 😷 back in July 🌞 while platforms like Game Pass 🎟️ created value 💰 but didn't grow 🌱 fast enough 🐢 amid the computing 💻 price crisis 🔥 and hardware costs 🛠️ soaring 📈 leaving everyone 😵 down bad 😩 at the company 🏢 that once ruled 👑 consoles since 2001 📅.

The latest bloodbath 🩸 hits hundreds 🙌 of staff 👷 at the Halo 🪐 studio itself 🏗️ with Call of Duty's 🍆 publisher Activision 🏪 now swooping in 🦅 to handle development 🛠️ of any future games 🎮 after this dramatic move 🎭 that Jez Corden 📰 of Windows Central called a total shakeup 🌪️ while analyst Christopher Dring 📊 wondered out loud 🗣️ if it could revive what was once Xbox's crown jewel 👑 but hasn't been for over a decade 🕰️ raising serious questions ❓ about the flagship franchise's 🍆 future 📈.

It also piles pressure 🗜️ onto other notable Xbox studios 🏬 including the Cambridge based 🎓 Ninja Theory 🥷 whose Bafta winning 🏆 Hellblade series 🎮 was supposed to get spun off 🔄 alongside four others 🧩 during the dramatic downsizing 📉 but now Matt Booty 👞 Xbox's chief content officer 📝 admitted in his Tuesday blog post 📝 that attempts to find a buyer 🛒 completely failed ❌ with two separate agreements 🤝 falling through 💥 so now the studio enters consultation 🗣️ with employees 👥 on a proposed closure 🚪 even though potential buyout talks 💼 are still limping along 🦿.

Of those four other affected companies 🏭 three have now returned to management 👔 while consultation for Arcane 🧙 remains under way 🚧 Booty added ➕ and Xbox confirmed yet another 268 ✂️ job cuts after Sharma revealed the most significant restructure 🔄 in Xbox history 📜 saying the company is already three quarters 🕒 of the way through its planned bloodletting 🩸 with workers left stunned 😱 after this ongoing jobs bloodbath 🩸 that has everyone feeling the hardware cost crunch 💸 and subscription growth stall 🛑.

Halo 🪐 has been the absolute hallmark 🏆 of the Xbox brand 🏷️ since Microsoft's very first console entry 🎮 in 2001 📅 helping establish the firm as a major player 🏆 in the industry 🏭 but now Halo Studios 🏗️ which recently dropped Halo Campaign Evolved 🆕 in July 🌞 will only support the community 🤝 and work on existing titles 🎮 instead of pumping out any new release 🚀 according to the announcement 📢 with Christopher Dring 📊 noting the military sci fi shooter 🔫 was once what Mario 🍄 is to Nintendo 🕹️ but years of mismanagement 🧩 have totally eroded that legacy 🏚️.

Rob Kostich 🧔 Activision's president 👔 dropped a hype quote 📢 saying for Halo our goal is crystal clear 🔎 make the greatest Halo game ever 🏆 worthy of its universe 🌌 and legacy 🏅 while staying true 💯 to what made players love it ❤️ in the first place 🛠️ and confirmed they have already begun assembling a purpose built team 👷 unique in capability 🦸 and talent 🧠 ready and excited 😤 to deliver this next chapter 📖 with the community 🫂 as Activision's remit expands 📈 to also manage World's Edge studio 🌍 home of Age of Empires 👑 plus Rare 🦜 and its Sea of Thieves 🏴‍☠️ series while Bethesda 🧙 gets to swallow Obsidian 🍽️ and Forza Horizon 🏎️ combines with Fable 🗡️ in more consolidations 🗃️ that keep the reset 🔄 rolling hard 💪.
